jd.text:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced AI Solution Architect with 8–10 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and enterprise solution architecture. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing scalable, secure, and high-performance AI solutions aligned with business objectives.
The candidate should have strong expertise in AI/ML architecture, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), cloud-based AI platforms, and enterprise system integration. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, data scientists, software engineers, and technology teams to translate business requirements into effective AI-driven solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI/ML solution architectures aligned with business requirements and enterprise technology standards.
Define AI strategy, architecture patterns, technology stacks, and implementation roadmaps.
Architect and implement AI, ML, Generative AI, and LLM-based solutions for enterprise use cases.
Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector database integrations, and knowledge retrieval pipelines.
Evaluate and select appropriate AI models, frameworks, platforms, and cloud services based on business and technical requirements.
Develop architecture for scalable AI applications, APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations.
Design and implement AI solutions using cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Establish best practices for model deployment, monitoring, versioning, performance optimization, and lifecycle management using MLOps principles.
Define responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, explainability, bias mitigation, and governance.
Assess the feasibility, scalability, cost, and business value of proposed AI solutions.
Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, developers, and business stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.
Develop architecture diagrams, technical specifications, proof of concepts (POCs), and implementation plans.
Guide development teams on AI architecture, coding standards, integration patterns, and deployment practices.
Monitor emerging AI technologies and recommend innovations that improve business outcomes.
Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise security, compliance, performance, availability, and reliability requirements.
Required Skills and Qualifications
8–10 years of experience in AI, Machine Learning, data science, software engineering, or AI-focused solution architecture.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale AI/ML solutions.
Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and predictive analytics.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, and LLM application development.
Experience designing RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search solutions.
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with AI/ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, or Hugging Face.
Experience with AI frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent technologies.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Understanding of data engineering concepts, data pipelines, data lakes, data warehouses, and data governance.
Knowledge of MLOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, model monitoring, and production deployment.
Strong understanding of AI security, data protection, responsible AI, and governance frameworks.
Excellent architectural design, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or equivalent services.
Experience implementing AI agents, tool calling, multi-agent workflows, and enterprise copilots.
Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or pgvector.
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Knowledge of model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, and AI observability.
Experience designing hybrid or multi-cloud AI architectures.
Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, AI/ML, or Generative AI.
Experience leading technical teams and presenting architecture solutions to senior stakeholders.
Key Competencies
AI/ML solution architecture and technology strategy.
Generative AI, LLMs, and RAG implementation.
Enterprise architecture and system integration.
Cloud-native AI solution design.
MLOps and production AI lifecycle management.
AI security, governance, and responsible AI.
Technical leadership and stakeholder collaboration.
Performance, scalability, and cost optimization.

jd.text:
You'll own the online systems that take a catalogue change to a ranked result in front of a shopper: search, retrieval and recommendation serving, the streaming data that keeps them fresh, and the experiments that ship them.
Salla is the leading e-commerce platform in MENA, serving about 68,000+ merchants. Our AI team is building a self-owned discovery stack across our marketplace and merchant stores: hybrid lexical and vector search, Arabic-first query understanding, and learned ranking shared between search and recommendations. Data scientists own the relevance and ranking models. You own the platform that makes them fast, fresh, reliable and shippable.
The work is roughly half online serving, a third streaming data, and the rest integration into product surfaces. You sit on the ML Platform team spending time between search and serving for our recommendation systems and work day to day with search data scientists and the ranking lead
What you'll do
Online serving
Build and run query and recommendation serving: retrieval, score fusion, filtering, caching.
Hold tight latency budgets, including double-digit-millisecond p95 for search-as-you-type.
Design graceful degradation, so serving holds up when a model or vector path is slow or down.
Build experiment plumbing: shadow traffic, A/B assignment, guardrail metrics, rollback.
Streaming data
Build change-data-capture from source systems into search indexes and feature stores, with measured freshness.
Keep embeddings fresh for new and updated items.
Run zero-downtime reindexing of multi-million-document collections.
Build feature logging that turns production traffic into training data for ranking models.
Integration
Ship changes into product teams' backends and clients: new endpoints, cutovers, experiment flags.
Work with product engineering teams on reviews, release windows and production ownership.
Operability, throughout
Monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and your share of on-call for what you ship.
Requirements
5+ years building backend or platform systems in production.
2+ years operating a production search engine (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, Typesense, Vespa or similar): index lifecycle, analyzers, reindexing at scale, debugging relevance issues with data scientists.
Low-latency services under real traffic, and the ability to explain where the p95 goes.
Streaming ingestion: Kafka, Debezium or similar change-data-capture, plus idempotent backfills.
Strong Python. Comfortable shipping in TypeScript.
Shipped changes through A/B tests and staged rollouts.
Daily use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code. We expect one engineer plus agents to cover what used to take a team.

jd.text:
Job Purpose
To develop and execute marketing initiatives for the bank's products and services, ensuring effective product positioning, customer engagement, and market penetration. The role focuses on promoting banking products, increasing product awareness and adoption, and supporting business growth through targeted marketing strategies and campaigns.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute marketing strategies and campaigns for banking products, including retail and corporate banking products and services.
Promote banking products such as personal finance, credit cards, mortgages, savings accounts, deposits, and other financial solutions.
Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Digital Banking, and Business teams to understand product features, value propositions, and business objectives.
Develop product positioning, key messages, and marketing materials to communicate product benefits and competitive advantages.
Plan and execute product launch campaigns, promotional offers, and customer acquisition initiatives.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify market trends, customer needs, and opportunities for product growth.
Develop targeted marketing campaigns based on customer segments, behaviors, and preferences.
Monitor campaign performance and evaluate effectiveness against KPIs, including customer acquisition, product penetration, conversion rates, and engagement.
Analyze customer insights and market feedback to recommend improvements to product marketing strategies.
Coordinate with creative agencies, media partners, and internal stakeholders to deliver marketing campaigns.
Ensure all product marketing communications comply with the bank's brand guidelines, internal policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Prepare marketing reports, campaign performance analysis, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
Requirements
Qualifications & Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in marketing, preferably within the banking or financial services sector.
Experience in planning, executing, and monitoring marketing campaigns.
Good understanding of banking products and financial services.
Knowledge of digital marketing channels, social media platforms, and marketing tools.
Experience in market research, competitor analysis, and customer segmentation.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor campaign KPIs and prepare performance reports.
Excellent communication, presentation, and coordination skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Preferred Certifications
Professional Marketing or Digital Marketing Certification.
Google Analytics or Digital Marketing certifications.
CIM or equivalent marketing qualification.
